elements.text: One Button, three variants. Square, 1px line, no glow at rest; corner ticks mean "this is the action". Bright on the faint frames.
gold · ticks · the one thing to do here

h 32 · px-4 · Rajdhani 600 12 caps, spaced · menus, close
h 40 · px-6 · Rajdhani 700 16 caps, spaced · the main call to action
rest faint · hover muted · current gold + glow (alive) · 10px, never smaller
5 hand-rolled buttons → Button quiet sm. Reset is danger. Labels mono 10, faint.

Touch: sm and md grow their hit area to 44px on coarse pointers (an invisible pad), not their box. Keyboard: Enter/Space, the focus ring always shows on :focus-visible. Loading: the label stays, a 1px signal line runs along the bottom edge.

No scale bounce (was 1.02 hover / 0.98 tap). Press = the active glow + a few palette sparks inside the button, clipped to it, ~500ms: the contained firework preview. Calm mode: a single rim flash. The burst itself is decided in Effects.

primary · secondary · ghost · glass variants and their 24 undefined --btn-* vars and 7 --glow-* vars · white/20 hand-rolled HUD buttons · 6–8px rail labels · #00ffff · sandbox raw bg-white/10 buttons (→ quiet sm).

knowledge.text: 4 kinds of button: gem/Button (5 variants, colors all undefined var(--btn-*)) used at InfoBar.tsx:37 and GameHUD.tsx:68 (+9 in SilkSandbox); 5 hand-rolled HUD buttons GameHUD.tsx:79-121; rail labels NavBar.tsx:37,96 at text-[6px] md:text-[8px] in #00ffff; raw buttons in NebulaSandbox.tsx:67-80.
One Button, three variants: action (gold), quiet (signal line, muted text), danger (ember).
knowledge.why: Covers every real use: the one call to action, the many secondary/HUD buttons, and Reset progress.

knowledge.text: Action is outlined gold: gold/10 tint, 1px gold line, gold text, 8px corner ticks (6 at sm). Ticks on a button mean "the action"; quiet and danger have none.
knowledge.why: Matches the AR frames; bright without a block of color.

knowledge.text: States: rest no glow · hover glow-hover, brighter text/line · focus 2px signal ring (focus-visible) · press glow-active + contained firework · disabled faint line and text, no ticks, no glow. No scale bounce.
Sizes sm 24 (mono 10) / md 32 (Rajdhani 600 12) / lg 40 (Rajdhani 700 16); 44px hit area on coarse pointers.
Rail labels are real buttons, mono 10 caps: rest faint, hover muted, current gold with a glowing gold dot.
knowledge.why: Gold = selected (Color); 6–8px was below the 10px floor (Type).

knowledge.text: Danger asks twice: the first press arms it ("RESET?" for 3s), the second does it.

agent.brief: One Button (shared/ui/Button.tsx, replaces gem/Button.tsx): variants action / quiet / danger, sizes sm / md / lg. Colors, type, glow, motion from the Foundation pages; --glow-color is the variant color.
rules: Base: `relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 uppercase border transition-[color,background-color,border-color,box-shadow] duration-fast ease-standard focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-signal disabled:cursor-not-allowed` + `[--glow-color:var(--color-<variant>)] hover:shadow-glow-hover active:shadow-glow-active` (not when disabled). No whileHover/whileTap scale.
action: `bg-gold/10 border-gold text-gold hover:bg-gold/16 active:bg-gold/22` + <Ticks size=8 (6 at sm) color=gold>. Used by: InfoBar LAUNCH SHIP (lg), SilkSandbox Close.

quiet: `border-signal/40 text-text-muted hover:border-signal/80 hover:text-text active:bg-signal/14`. Used by: GameHUD Disengage (md), GameHUD zoom −/+, Lines on/off, Unlock (sm), every SilkSandbox / NebulaSandbox button (sm).
danger: `border-ember/40 text-text-muted hover:border-ember hover:text-ember active:bg-ember/14` — glow ember. Used by: GameHUD Reset (sm).
disabled (all): `border-text-faint/35 text-text-faint bg-transparent shadow-none`, ticks hidden. Replaces disabled:opacity-20.

Sizes: sm `h-6 px-2 font-mono text-micro tracking-wide`; md `h-8 px-4 font-display font-semibold text-small tracking-spaced`; lg `h-10 px-6 font-display font-bold text-lead tracking-spaced`. On `(pointer: coarse)` sm/md get a `before:absolute before:-inset-y-[10px] before:-inset-x-1` hit pad (44px).
Old variant map: primary → action; secondary, ghost, glass → quiet; danger → danger. Old size map: sm → sm, md → md, lg → lg. glow prop deleted (glow is the state, not an option).
loading: label kept, aria-busy, a 1px signal line scans along the bottom edge (DUR.slow loop; reduced motion: static line).

Rail (NavBar.tsx): labels → <button> `font-mono text-micro uppercase tracking-wide`: rest text-faint, hover text-muted, current (aria-current="true") text-gold; the current dot bg-gold + shadow-glow-active with --glow-color gold; other dots bg-text/35; stems current gold else text-faint. #00ffff, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), text-[6px]/[8px] deleted.
HUD row labels (Zoom, Lines, Unlock): `font-mono text-micro uppercase tracking-spaced text-text-faint`; counters (15, 3/12) text-muted. The dev group sits on a Plate.
Press: the contained firework (Effects); until Effects is decided, press = active glow only.
Sandbox inputs (checkbox, range) are dev-only: out of scope.
